calls.statement:
SELECT week_ending_date, count(*) AS n, count(DISTINCT (store_key, product_key)) AS distinct_keys, count(DISTINCT etl_loaded_at) AS loads, min(etl_loaded_at) AS first_load, max(etl_loaded_at) AS last_load, sum(closing_value) AS val
FROM fact_stock_week
WHERE week_ending_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-02-20' AND DATE '2026-03-31'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH w AS (
  SELECT *, count(*) OVER (PARTITION BY store_key, product_key) AS c
  FROM fact_stock_week WHERE week_ending_date = DATE '2026-03-08'
)
SELECT etl_loaded_at, c, count(*) AS n, sum(closing_units) AS u, sum(closing_value) AS v, sum(receipts_units) AS r, sum(adjustment_units) AS a
FROM w GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

WITH a AS (SELECT * FROM fact_stock_week WHERE week_ending_date = DATE '2026-03-08' AND etl_loaded_at = TIMESTAMP '2026-03-09 01:00:00'),
b AS (SELECT * FROM fact_stock_week WHERE week_ending_date = DATE '2026-03-08' AND etl_loaded_at = TIMESTAMP '2026-03-10 02:45:00')
SELECT count(*) AS pairs, sum(CASE WHEN a.closing_units = b.closing_units THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS same_units, sum(CASE WHEN a.closing_value = b.closing_value THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS same_val,
 sum(a.closing_value) AS a_val, sum(b.closing_value) AS b_val, (SELECT count(*) FROM a) AS na, (SELECT count(*) FROM b) AS nb
FROM a JOIN b USING (store_key, product_key)

SELECT s.store_id, s.store_name, s.region AS region_then, cs.region AS region_now, cs.is_current, fs.week_ending_date, count(*) AS n
FROM fact_stock_week fs JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = fs.store_key JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id = s.store_id AND cs.is_current
WHERE fs.week_ending_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-02-22' AND DATE '2026-03-22'
  AND (cs.region = 'West' OR s.region = 'West' OR s.store_id >= 900)
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1, 6

WITH dedup AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT store_key, product_key, week_ending_date, closing_units, closing_value
  FROM fact_stock_week
  WHERE week_ending_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-02-23' AND DATE '2026-03-22'
),
rows_ AS (
  SELECT d.week_ending_date, cs.store_id, cp.sku, d.product_key, p.category AS cat_then, cp.category AS cat_now, d.closing_units, d.closing_value
  FROM dedup d
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = d.store_key
  JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id = s.store_id AND cs.is_current
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = d.product_key
  JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = p.sku AND cp.is_current
  WHERE cs.region = 'West' AND s.store_id < 900
)
SELECT count(*) AS n, count(DISTINCT (week_ending_date, store_id, sku)) AS dist_grain, sum(CASE WHEN cat_then <> cat_now THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cat_changed,
  sum(CASE WHEN closing_units < 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS neg_units, sum(CASE WHEN closing_value < 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS neg_val,
  sum(CASE WHEN cat_now = 'ZZ Test' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS test_rows, count(DISTINCT cat_now) AS ncat
FROM rows_

WITH dedup AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT store_key, product_key, week_ending_date, closing_units, closing_value
  FROM fact_stock_week WHERE week_ending_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-02-23' AND DATE '2026-03-22'
)
SELECT d.week_ending_date, count(*) AS n, sum(d.closing_value) AS val, sum(d.closing_units * p.standard_unit_cost) AS units_x_cost,
  sum(CASE WHEN abs(d.closing_value - d.closing_units * p.standard_unit_cost) > 0.05 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mismatches
FROM dedup d JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = d.store_key JOIN dim_store c ON c.store_id = s.store_id AND c.is_current
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = d.product_key
WHERE c.region = 'West' AND s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH dedup AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT store_key, product_key, week_ending_date, closing_units, closing_value
  FROM fact_stock_week
  WHERE week_ending_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-02-23' AND DATE '2026-03-22'
),
weekly AS (
  SELECT d.week_ending_date, cp.category, SUM(d.closing_value) AS closing_value
  FROM dedup d
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = d.store_key
  JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id = s.store_id AND cs.is_current
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = d.product_key
  JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = p.sku AND cp.is_current
  WHERE cs.region = 'West' AND s.store_id < 900 AND cp.category <> 'ZZ Test'
  GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT 'FY2025/26' AS fiscal_year, 11 AS fiscal_period, category,
       ROUND(AVG(closing_value), 2) AS avg_weekly_closing_stock_value, COUNT(*) AS weeks
FROM weekly GROUP BY category ORDER BY category
